title: Tokyo Shader Forge: Material Alchemy Lab
description: The user operates a shader laboratory set in a miniature Tokyo diorama. Carbon fibre panels float around the scene as material sample targets, while translucent plants grow from rooftops responding to shader energy. Users mix custom shader properties across all three assets using coupled sliders, with a conservation law ensuring total shader energy remains constant, and full undo/redo support.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net. Load LittlestTokyo.glb as the central diorama, CarbonFibre.glb as 4 floating panels orbiting the city, and DiffuseTransmissionPlant.glb as 3 plants placed on the diorama. Use GLTFLoader and OrbitControls. Camera at (8,6,8) looking at origin. Add hemisphere light (sky 0x88ccff, ground 0x443322, intensity 1.5) and a directional light with shadows. Create a UI panel with these coupled shader controls: (1) Emission Energy slider 0-1 controlling emissive intensity on Tokyo buildings via custom ShaderMaterial uniform injection by traversing meshes and modifying onBeforeCompile to inject a uniform u_emission. (2) Reflectance slider 0-1 controlling metalness and envMap intensity on CarbonFibre panels. (3) Transmission slider 0-1 controlling opacity and transmission-like diffuse effect on plants by modifying their material's opacity and adding a custom fragment shader chunk for subsurface glow. (4) Fresnel Power slider 0.5-5.0 controlling a rim-light fresnel effect added via onBeforeCompile to ALL assets. Implement a CONSERVATION LAW: Emission + Reflectance + Transmission must always equal 1.0. When one slider increases, the other two decrease proportionally. Display the energy budget as a colored bar. Fresnel Power is independent. Implement full UNDO/REDO: every slider release saves state to a history stack. Pressing Z undoes, Y redoes, restoring all four values and updating all materials. Add a color picker that sets the base tint for the fresnel rim light across all objects. Clicking any carbon fibre panel should toggle it between wireframe and solid, counting as an undoable action. Animate the Tokyo model mixer if animations exist. Orbit the carbon panels slowly around the diorama at radius 5. Show current slider values and history stack depth in the UI. Minimum interaction path: adjust emission, adjust reflectance (auto-adjusts transmission), change fresnel, pick color, toggle 2 panels wireframe, undo twice, redo once, adjust transmission, toggle another panel, adjust fresnel again. That is 12 steps.
